forum-shot.card-table.column-card.note: Column header of the card table: the name of the Magic Card.

forum-shot.card-table.column-dashboard.note: Column header of the card table: the dashboard a card is on.

forum-shot.card-table.column-status.note: Column header of the card table: whether the card can be used.

forum-shot.card-table.column-view.note: Column header of the card table: the view (tab) of the dashboard a card is on.

forum-shot.card-table.default-dashboard.note: Name shown for the dashboard that Home Assistant opens first, which has no title of its own.

forum-shot.card-table.fonts-from.note: Line under a usable card that uses fonts from other websites. {hosts} is a list of website domain names, such as example.com, already joined with commas; do not translate it.

vars.hosts: The value that replaces hosts in the text.

forum-shot.card-table.reason-cannot-judg.text: Its settings could not be checked for outside addresses.
forum-shot.card-table.reason-cannot-judg.note: Reason a card is locked: the check could not tell whether an address is safe.

forum-shot.card-table.reason-custom-card.text: It holds another card (a custom-card module) that nothing here can check.
forum-shot.card-table.reason-custom-card.note: Reason a card is locked: it contains a custom-card module.

forum-shot.card-table.reason-limit.text: It names more outside websites than a forum shot allows.
forum-shot.card-table.reason-limit.note: Reason a card is locked: it names too many outside websites or is too large to check.

forum-shot.card-table.reason-outside-add.text: It loads something from outside Home Assistant.
forum-shot.card-table.reason-outside-add.note: Reason a card is locked: it names an address outside Home Assistant that is not an allowed font.

forum-shot.card-table.status-available.note: Status of a card that can be picked for a forum shot.

forum-shot.card-table.status-locked.note: Status of a card that cannot be picked. A reason follows it.

forum-shot.element.admin-only.text: Only the default dashboard is listed, because listing the others needs an administrator account.
forum-shot.element.admin-only.note: Note for a user who is not an administrator, shown above the list of cards.

forum-shot.element.cards-legend.note: Legend of the group of radio buttons where the user picks one card.

forum-shot.element.config-read-failed.text: Your dashboards could not be read. Check that they are not YAML dashboards, then try again.
forum-shot.element.config-read-failed.note: Error when no dashboard configuration could be read.

forum-shot.element.custom-card.text: This card holds another card inside it (a custom-card module). That card can load pictures from outside Home Assistant and nothing here can check it, so this card cannot be used for a forum shot.
forum-shot.element.custom-card.note: Notice next to a card that cannot be picked because it holds a custom-card module. Also the error when the picture is refused for that reason.

forum-shot.element.download.note: Button that makes the picture and saves it to the user's device.

forum-shot.element.error-capture-failed.text: The picture could not be made in this browser. Try again, or use another browser.

forum-shot.element.error-card-not-define.text: The Magic Card is not loaded in this browser tab. Reload the page and try again.
forum-shot.element.error-card-not-define.note: Error when the card element is not available.

forum-shot.element.error-too-large.text: The picture would be too large. Choose light or dark only, or turn off the three looks.
forum-shot.element.error-too-large.note: Error when the sheet would exceed the size limit.

forum-shot.element.font-host-contact.text: To draw the fonts, your browser asks {hosts} for them. Those sites can see your IP address, the time of the request, which fonts you ask for and the ordinary details every browser sends, such as its type and language. Your cards and settings are not sent.
forum-shot.element.font-host-contact.note: Privacy notice under the preview of a card that uses fonts from other websites, naming who is contacted and what they learn. {hosts} is a list of website domain names, such as example.com, already joined with commas; do not translate it.

vars.hosts: The value that replaces hosts in the text.

forum-shot.element.forum-shot.note: Accessible name of the forum shot area in the Magic Card Utils panel, where the user turns a Magic Card into one picture to post in a forum.

forum-shot.element.intro.text: Pick one of your Magic Cards and save it as a picture to post in a forum.
forum-shot.element.intro.note: Short introduction under the heading of the forum shot area.

forum-shot.element.loading.note: Status text while the dashboards are read.

forum-shot.element.local-only.text: The picture is made in your browser. Nothing leaves Home Assistant, and Magic Card does not keep a copy.
forum-shot.element.local-only.note: Sentence under the privacy warning: the picture is made locally and nothing is stored.

forum-shot.element.local-only-font.text: The picture is made in your browser, and Magic Card does not keep a copy. Your cards and settings stay in Home Assistant, but the fonts are fetched from the sites named here.
forum-shot.element.local-only-font.note: Sentence under the privacy warning for a card that uses fonts from other websites: the picture is made locally, nothing is stored, and the fonts come from outside.

forum-shot.element.looks.text: Show the Quiet, Living and Glow looks of animated icons, one row each
forum-shot.element.looks.note: Checkbox: the picture gets three rows, one per look of the animated icons.

forum-shot.element.making.note: Status text while the picture is made.

forum-shot.element.mode-both.note: Option: the picture holds a light and a dark version of the card side by side.

forum-shot.element.mode-dark.note: Option: the picture holds only the dark version of the card.

forum-shot.element.mode-light.note: Option: the picture holds only the light version of the card.

forum-shot.element.modes-legend.note: Legend of the group where the user chooses light, dark or both.

forum-shot.element.no-cards.text: No Magic Cards were found on your dashboards.
forum-shot.element.no-cards.note: Empty state when no dashboard holds a Magic Card.

forum-shot.element.notice-remote-placeho.text: A picture from outside Home Assistant was replaced by a placeholder, so no other server was contacted. Your card may look different on your dashboard.
forum-shot.element.notice-remote-placeho.note: Notice under the preview when an image from another server was left out.

forum-shot.element.notice-remote-placeho.text: A picture from outside Home Assistant was replaced by a placeholder, and no server was asked for it. Your card may look different on your dashboard.
forum-shot.element.notice-remote-placeho.note: Notice under the preview of a card that uses fonts from other websites, when an image from another server was left out.

forum-shot.element.pick-first.note: Hint shown while no card is picked, so the Download button is not available.

forum-shot.element.preview-alt.text: Preview of the forum shot picture
forum-shot.element.preview-alt.note: Text alternative of the preview image.

forum-shot.element.privacy-hint.text: Check the picture before you post it. A card can show names, places, camera images and the state of your devices, and everyone who sees your post can see them too.
forum-shot.element.privacy-hint.note: Privacy warning shown before the Download button.

forum-shot.element.remote-asset.text: This card loads an image, a web address or another file from outside Home Assistant that cannot be checked. It cannot be used for a forum shot, because making the picture would contact an unchecked server.
forum-shot.element.remote-asset.note: Notice next to a card that cannot be picked because its settings name something outside Home Assistant. Also the error when the picture is refused for that reason.

forum-shot.element.retry.note: Button that reads the dashboards again after an error.

forum-shot.element.saved.text: The picture was saved to your downloads.
forum-shot.element.saved.note: Status text after the picture was saved.
